title: Chapter 1062
paragraphs: Chapter 1062
Episode 252. The War Begins (1)

"Soldiers. Today is the first day we start a full-scale war against Ziffle. From today, we will persistently chase, attack, tear apart, and bring them to their knees until the name Ziffle disappears from this world. Is everyone ready?"
"Yes!"
Jin stared at the images floating on the bridge. Thanks to the technology absorbed from the Red Plutonian, the images showed the members of the alliance aboard each fleet.
"Coordinates are set, Lord."
Mesa turned to Jin and said. She, along with the youngest division, had become crew members of the Runkandel 1st Fleet, the flagship.
"All fleets, initiate spatial leap."
"Understood!"
Upon Jin's command, nearly six hundred ships prepared for a spatial leap, creating a spectacular scene.
Giant dimensional gates were opening across the sky. Ships entered one by one into the vortex of silver and steel.

Although flying ships had become common compared to a few years ago, the power of the golden ships was on a different level. Each ship was comparable to the Kozec, Ziffle's ultimate weapon until then.
Even so, the fleet gathered above Tikan did not constitute even half of the alliance's total force.
Yet, victory was not assured.
Rather, Jin thought they were still at a disadvantage, given the immense power of the 'Origin Stone.'
The reports from Ban and Valeria alone were enough to speculate this.

They experienced 'manipulation' while tracking the Tower of Story. Suddenly, islands appeared out of nowhere in the sky, blocking their way, deserts turned into seas, tsunamis rose to the altitude where the fleet was flying, the Tower of Story, which was in front of them, disappeared in an instant, and enemy fleets appeared in its place.
All these were reality manipulations through the power of the Origin Stone.
'We're not yet at the point where we can manipulate the history of our alliance like Ziffle did a thousand years ago, but we never know when it might start.'
They were all determined to end the war before the Origin Stone reached that stage.
Wooong...
As the vibration of the fleet's power source subsided, the spatial leap of the entire fleet was completed.
The scene that appeared was a vast sea.
The fact that the desert was turning into a sea due to the Origin Stone had already been communicated to all members of the alliance.
But facing that scene directly brought an indescribable sense of disorientation.
The odd appearance of sand dunes floating like islands was the only indicator that this was not any sea but the Sota Desert.

'The scenery is much different from when I came on a secret construction yard destruction mission 4 years ago. Back then, the sight of the numerous ships Ziffle was building was shocking, but now that seems like nothing compared to the Origin Stone.'
Among them, about a hundred ships from the Divine Fleet were floating. Despite numerous attacks during the chase, not a single scratch could be found on those ships.
{You've arrived, Brother Jin. As we've confirmed so far, their reality manipulation definitely has limits. Do you see the Tower of Story now?}
"I see it, brother."
Jin said, peering beyond the bridge.
The Tower of Story was considered the last territory left to Ziffle. However, the tower had now become an aerial fortress of a size comparable to 'Ram,' which was operated by the ancient demon.
"It appears as though seen through a broken mirror."

{It's not even visible from my side, brother. If you can see it from where you are, it means, as we and Valeria have figured out, they can't perform all-around spatial distortions. Attack now while they are visible. We must press on relentlessly to expose such openings.}
"Understood. All fleets, attack the enemy!"
Once again, the power sources of the ships began to roar.
The front of every golden ship split into two, revealing the main cannons. Simultaneously, Jin and Ban amplified their hearts of light to the maximum.
The power source of the golden ship
s was the heart of light, the energy of the Plutonian. And this energy was influenced by the resonance of the Plutonian' divine bodies, just like Jin and Ban's hearts of light.
Rapidly and continuously expanding, the energy enveloped the entire fleet in an instant.
The energy, spreading like a nebula, became a terrifying weapon in itself. The sea formed by Ziffle boiled like lava under its heat, and hot gales whirled in all directions.
Kwaaaaaah... Kiiing-!
The moment the entire fleet's bombardment began, the Tower of Story had to face firepower that had never existed in human history before.
Blinding, azure lightning.
The Tower of Story was momentarily engulfed in a vast blue light, disappearing from everyone's sight. Explosions, thunderous roars, and shockwaves seemed to shake the entire world.
Most members of the alliance were thrilled by that power. Literally, it was a destructive force capable of changing the world map at will.
However, the warriors staying near the explosion and in its vicinity quietly observed the enemy beyond
the explosion.
'There's no feeling of hitting the target.'

The bombardment had indeed exploded upon hitting something, but it wasn't the Tower of Story itself. It was either a protective shield or something the tower had formed in its place while attempting a spatial leap.
By the time the explosion reached its intermediate stage, the warriors were convinced that they had not inflicted any damage.
However, this was not a reason for despair.
'The fact that they avoided the bombardment means it was too burdensome for them to block directly. Besides, it was just one round of firing, not a significant attack from our side.'
It could have been a trap.
They might have avoided the bombardment on purpose, planning to launch a powerful counterattack at a more crucial moment. But Jin decided to dismiss that possibility.
'They seem to need time, having fled from our pursuit until now. And we cannot annihilate them without taking risks.'
The enemy was not just the Ziffle of this dimension. The Demon Race, Ziffle's support from multiple worlds, could start at any moment.
They always had to be ready to fight with risks. Those gathered here were the last great adversaries across all dimensions.
"The Tower of Story has been reacquired! It's at the front upper part of the 1st flagship!"
The Tower of Story, reappearing after the bombardment, now took on an ordinary form, resembling a white disc. Its immense size made the central tower protrude sharply, looking almost like chalk.

The Divine Fleet's location once again did not allow for a view of the Tower of Story. Trying to join the direction in response to the alliance's communication, Ziffle's fleet suddenly appeared in their flight path.
"Kuk!"
Suddenly, the warriors of the Divine Fleet felt as if their heads were about to explode.

The constant spatial distortions and reality manipulations were causing inner turmoil among the warriors. Just as the voice of chaos drives people into fear, the manipulation by the Origin Stone had a tormenting power of its own.
However, the warriors were merely startled for a moment and did not care much. The pain, akin to delusion, was bearable as long as it wasn't actual physical damage.
The fleet formed in front of the Divine Fleet was entirely composed of Kozec 2. As before, this fleet was likely manned by phantoms created through reality manipulation.
But there was one difference.
{Is that... the Red Plutonian's aerial fortress?}
Usrok.
The aerial fortress that Ziffle had stolen in the past. The fleet formed by Ziffle this time included an aerial fortress identical to Usrok at its center.
It was uncertain whether this Usrok was real or a fake created through manipulation.

{Even if it's a fake, it should possess about 70% of the original Red Plutonian's aerial fortress's power. The fake fleets and phantom crews they've created until now have been so. It feels like they're extremely wary of my fleet joining, Brother Jin.}
Jin nodded.
Indeed, Ziffle seemed more cautious of the Divine Fleet led by Jin and the constant pursuit than of the alliance's fleet.
Jin thought he understood the reason.
The Plutonian Domination Sword
Though its pure firepower might be less than the fleet bombardment, if Ban could fully deploy the Plutonian Domination Sword while attached to a hull, firepower wouldn't be an issue.
That sword could not be manipulated or avoided by the current Origin Stone. An non manipulable force, the real threat Ziffle felt now was just that.
Moreover, Valeria was aboard the Divine Fleet. Along with the Plutonian Domination Sword, her record magic could also create problematic variables at any time.
Kwaaaa!
Usrok's main cannon pounded on the Divine Fleet's shield. It seemed to possess about 70% of the original Red Plutonian's aerial fortress's power, as Ban said.
That 70% might have dominated the skies until recently, but not anymore.

Even after being directly hit by Usrok's main cannon, the Divine Fleet's shield showed no sign of destruction. The bombardment from Usrok and the fake fleets couldn't even penetrate the energy field spread near the shield.
{Brother Jin, let me clear the path first. I'll deal with these fakes and join you.}
Ban communicated with a smile, thinking Ziffle was too focused on her alone. To Ban, the blade that would most terrify Ziffle was not her but Jin's.
"Initiate the second round of firin
g. We'll lower the output."
Jin's heart of light calmed down, and the resonance with the golden fleet's power source weakened.
Excluding the Divine Fleet, the main canons of all ships fired again. Even with reduced output, the energy was still enough to fill the sky.
The Tower of Story avoided the bombardment again by rapidly ascending through a spatial leap. The attack missed, but the tower did not disappear from sight.
As the firing began to subside, Jin drew Bra
mante.
"Open the bridge and all ships except the 1st flagship Sara disperse, make sure not to get in the way of my sword."
"Roger!"
The moment Jin leaped outside the bridge, runes began to shine on the hull of the ship Sara.
Just as runes appeared on Jin's body when he deployed the secret techniques of the ten knights, Sara Runkandel's magic sword.
Jin had been thinking for a while.
To punish 'Ziffle,' no sword was more fitting than this.
Runkandel Magic Sword Technique
Eternal Flame – Sara Runkandel [업화 – 사라 룬칸델]
"The sword you thought was completely erased from history has never disappeared since I met Lady Sara. And it will continue to be so in the future."
